sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: CAA/EAA artwork gallery: a 🖼 button after 📊 in every table's artwork controls (and "🖼 Open gallery" in the 📊 summary) opens a movable, resizable window with every image of the releases the table currently shows, grouped by release and labelled with format, country/date, label and catalog number. Type chips show only those images and name the releases without one ("No Medium image"); "Compare two" lines two releases up type by type. A click opens the artwork viewer, whose Shift+← → step through the gallery's releases. It asks the archive for nothing: a release still loading shows "loading…" and fills in while the window is open.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: New settings (⚙️ → 🖼️ CAA/EAA ILLUSTRATED DISCOGRAPHY): artwork gallery on/off, its tile size, and its "Compare two" view. The window's position and size travel with a config export.
